Follovving are the characteristics of alkaline earth metals:
a. The elements of group IIA of modern periodic table are alkaline earth metals.

i. They are divalent elements and are highly electropositive elements. ii- They have oxidation state +2. iii. They are malleable, ductile and good conductor of heat and electricity. iv- They generally form ionic compounds. v. They react with hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, halogens to form hydride, oxide, nitride, and halides vi. They act as reducing agent.
